newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks sell-off ahead of jobs data.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks sell-off ahead of jobs data.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks got trounced on Thursday, dropping 1.59 percent, as lower than expected weekly jobless claims sent bonds into a tailspin.
Analysts see the number as a harbinger of Friday's August payroll report.
Analysts also said that there was concern in the market about what kind of earnings reports the third quarter will produce, particularly in the high techs.
"There is beginning to be some talk about preannouncements in the third quarter," one analyst said. "Traders are fearful that we will get a slew of them over the next few weeks."
The Nasdaq Composite Index was down 18.15 points at 1125.67 while declines led advancing issues by 2457 to 1563 on volume of about 471 million shares.

Shares of Macromedia Inc were down 3-11/16 at 3-11/16 after Morgan Stanley cut the stock to neutral from outperform. The company said on Wednesday that it expected results in its second fiscal quarter to be flat.
Modem maker U.S. Robotics Corp fell on Thursday in heavy trading, pressured by rumors that some manufacturers were experiencing a decline in demand.
